content: The information provided here was last updated in May 2024. It is crucial to understand how to use this information appropriately. Adding plans enables you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs within the same therapeutic class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans allows you to make informed comparisons. However, the information provided here is for general informational and educational purposes only. Individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
